info.name: Matchmaking Platform API
info.description:
Phases 3-14: base API, authentication (registration, OTP, login, live presence verification, JWT, logout), profiles with profile pictures, and preferences, hobbies and quiz answers.

Run the folders in order (they share collection variables). Requires the backend running in development with OTP_PROVIDER=dev,
because OTP codes are read from the development outbox (GET /dev/otp). Command line:
  npx newman run docs/postman/matchmaking-platform.postman_collection.json --working-dir docs/postman

Authentication: protected requests send `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`. The access token is only issued by
POST /auth/login-verification/complete, after credentials/OTP AND the live face-presence check succeeded. Phase 8 & 9: Match Ranking & Recommendations added.

Phase 10 (folder 12): connection requests and connections. Set connectionReceiverId and receiverAccessToken first.
Phase 11 (folder 13): private chat REST endpoints. Set chatPartnerId and chatPartnerAccessToken (an ACCEPTED connection) first.
Folder 13 also sends/downloads an image (pick a file in the form-data "image" field). Folder 16: blocking (runs last).
Socket.IO events: run `npm run smoke:chat` (see docs/phase-11-chat.md).
Folder 14: video calls (REST). Folder 15: privacy settings & reports (Phase 13). Signalling is Socket.IO only (npm run e2e:video).
Folder 17: admin panel (Phase 14) — needs adminAccessToken.

request.description: Requires Bearer token. Returns the signed-in user's own profile; 404 until it is created.

exec: pm.test('error body', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.include({ success: false, message: "Profile not found. Create your profile first." }));

request.description:
Requires Bearer token. JSON body.
Required: name (2-100 chars), dateOfBirth (YYYY-MM-DD, age 18-100).
Optional (null or "" clears): gender (male|female|non_binary|other|prefer_not_to_say), city, state, country, education, occupation, lifestyle, bio (max 2000).
The user is taken from the token, never from the body. Returns the profile with computed age, location and profileCompletion. 409 if it already exists.

exec: pm.test('computed age and location', () => { pm.expect(d.age).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(d.location).to.eql('Kolhapur, Maharashtra, India'); pm.expect(d.profilePhotoUrl).to.eql(null); });

request.description: Requires Bearer token. JSON body with any subset of the profile fields; only provided fields change.
Account and security fields (userId, user_id, role, status, password_hash, email, profile_photo_url) are rejected.

Requires Bearer token. multipart/form-data with one file in the "photo" field.
JPG, PNG or WEBP up to PROFILE_IMAGE_MAX_SIZE_MB (default 5 MB). Any image is accepted: no face or human detection.
Stored as WEBP (max 1024 px, metadata removed). Replaces the previous picture.
Errors: 415 unsupported type, 413 too large, 422 missing or corrupt file, 404 no profile yet.

exec: pm.test('error body', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.include({ success: false, message: "Unsupported image type. Use a JPG, PNG or WEBP image." }));

item.name: POST /preferences — create (with hobbies and quiz, one transaction)

request.description:
Requires Bearer token. JSON body; every field optional:
preferredLocation (<=150), preferredEducation (<=150), preferredOccupation (<=150), preferredLifestyle (<=100),
preferredFood (vegetarian|non_vegetarian|eggetarian|vegan|jain|no_preference), partnerMinAge/partnerMaxAge (18-100, min <= max),
preferredGenders (female|male|non_binary|other), hobbyIds (<=20 unique active ids), quizAnswers ([{ questionId, answer }]).
All parts are saved in one transaction. 409 if preferences already exist. Unknown keys (user_id, userId, role) -> 422.
Requires Bearer token. Any subset of the POST fields; only provided fields change; null clears. Same single transaction.
Requires Bearer token. Body { hobbyIds: [...] }: the complete new selection (empty list clears). Ids must exist, be active and be unique.

exec: pm.test('error body', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.include({ success: false, message: "Validation failed" }));

request.description: Returns paginated candidates sorted by Phase 7 compatibility score DESC. Requires valid Bearer token.
Filters narrow the candidate pool before ranking but do not alter the compatibility formula.
limit=0 violates min(1) → 422 Validation failed
No Authorization header → 401 Authentication required
Returns full compatibility breakdown + whyThisMatch. Also logs profile_view interaction event for Phase 9 ML.
Cannot request match details with yourself → 400
Either direction block → 403 This profile is not accessible

item.name: 12. Connections (Phase 10)
item.description:
Connection requests and connection management. The sender/actor is ALWAYS the token owner; senderId/userId in a body is ignored.
Before running, set collection variables: connectionReceiverId (another active user WITH a profile) and receiverAccessToken (that user's access token, from a second login).
Lifecycle: pending -> accepted | rejected | cancelled; accepted -> disconnected. See backend/docs/phase-10-connections.md.

exec: pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("You cannot send a connection request to yourself."));
pm.test('points to incoming request', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.match(/already sent you a connection request/));

request.description: Relationship state for the connection button: none | pending_outgoing | pending_incoming | connected | rejected | unavailable.

exec: pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("This connection request is no longer pending."));

item.name: 13. Private chat (Phase 11)
item.description:
Private messaging between ACCEPTED connections. The sender/reader is always the token owner.
Before running, set collection variables: chatPartnerId (a user you have an ACCEPTED connection with) and chatPartnerAccessToken (that user's access token).
Real-time delivery uses Socket.IO on the same server/port (events: conversation:join, message:send, message:received, message:delivered, message:read, typing:start/stop, presence:update). Postman collections cannot script Socket.IO; see backend/docs/phase-11-chat.md.

exec: pm.test('stored as plain text, status sent', () => pm.expect(m).to.include({ message: 'Hello from Postman! stays plain text', status: 'sent', type: 'text' }));

item.name: POST /messages - not connected (receiver from folder 12, request cancelled) -> 403

exec: pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Messaging is available only between connected users."));
pm.test('contains the message, delivered by loading', () => pm.expect(d.messages.find((m) => m.id === Number(pm.variables.get('chatMessageId'))).status).to.eql('delivered'));
pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Only the recipient can mark a message as read."));

item.name: POST /messages/images - send an image (choose a JPG/PNG/WEBP file)

formdata.description: Pick a JPG, PNG or WEBP image (max CHAT_IMAGE_MAX_SIZE_MB)

request.description: Multipart upload. The image is re-encoded (metadata stripped) and stored privately; the response has image.path, served only to the two participants. Select a file for the "image" field before sending.

item.name: 14. Video calls (Phase 12)
item.description:
Call control and history over REST. WebRTC signalling (call:offer / call:answer / call:ice-candidate) is Socket.IO only — see backend/docs/phase-12-video-calls.md; `npm run e2e:video` runs a real two-browser call.
Uses chatPartnerId / chatPartnerAccessToken from folder 13 (an ACCEPTED connection).

exec: pm.test('contains the call, metadata only', () => { const h = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(h.calls.map((c) => c.id)).to.include(Number(pm.variables.get('callId'))); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(h)).not.to.match(/sdp|candidate|credential/i); });

item.name: 15. Privacy settings & reports (Phase 13)
item.description: Own privacy settings (enforced server-side wherever profile data is returned), another member's privacy-filtered profile, and user reports. Uses chatPartnerId / chatPartnerAccessToken from folder 13.

item.name: GET /profile/:userId - partner sees my filtered profile

exec: pm.test('location hidden, no account data', () => { pm.expect(p.location).to.eql(null); pm.expect(p.hiddenFields).to.include('location'); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(p)).not.to.match(/email|mobile|password|dateOfBirth/i); });

item.name: POST /reports - same open report again -> 200 (no duplicate)
GET /reports - the reported user sees none of them
16. Blocking (Phase 13)
item.description: Block / unblock. A block works in both directions and ENDS the connection (accepted → disconnected), closes chats and ends calls. Unblocking restores nothing. Runs last: it disconnects the folder-13 pair.

exec: pm.test('neutral message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('You cannot message this user.'));

item.name: POST /messages - after unblock still not connected -> 403

exec: pm.test('connection was ended by the block', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Messaging is available only between connected users.'));

item.name: 17. Admin panel (Phase 14)
item.description:
Admin API. Needs adminAccessToken / adminUserId: register an account, promote it (npm run admin:promote -- <email>),
then sign in via POST /admin/login + POST /auth/login-verification/complete. Every route requires role=admin
(ordinary users get 403). Uses chatPartnerId and reportId from earlier folders. Never paste real tokens into a shared collection.
